transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because I just don’t care about anything anymore. I used to do art classes, board-game nights, hiking, and I wanted to get back on the soccer team, but now I don’t do any of it. I just sit in my room and let everything slip away.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Since shortly after my divorce… so, about a year and eleven months now.
Have you ever had periods lasting several days or more where you felt unusually energetic, wired, or needed much less sleep than usual?
I’m not really sure what you mean. I haven’t noticed anything like that, I guess.
Before this past year and eleven months, have you ever had another time in your life when you felt depressed or lost interest like this?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had bad days before, but nothing that went on like this.
During this past year and eleven months, have there been any times where you felt back to your normal self for more than a couple of months?
No. I haven’t really felt like myself again for that long. Most of the time I’ve been deeply depressed and not interested in much of anything—like my life is already over.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself, or felt that you would be better off dead?
Yeah. I keep thinking I just don’t want to wake up anymore. When my friend found me, I’d been saying out loud that I couldn’t keep living like this.
How has your sleep been during this time?
It’s been bad. I lie awake for hours checking the door and listening for things. Then when I finally do fall asleep, I wake up before dawn shaking, and I can’t get back to sleep.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight during this time?
Yeah. I barely eat most days because food just tastes like cardboard. My jeans are so loose now I have to knot the waistband to keep them up.
How have your energy levels been lately?
I’m exhausted all the time. Even if I’ve been in bed most of the day, taking a shower or answering one text feels like I’ve worked a full shift.
Have you been experiencing strong feelings of worthlessness or excessive guilt?

Yeah. I keep going over every little thing I did wrong in my marriage and with my friends. It feels like I’ve messed up so much that... sometimes I think people would be safer, and less burdened, if I were gone.
